name: monitor
description: A Monitor pane and band for the session: the plan as a graph (fed by its plan tool), your prompts, the PR stack, and the usage limits. Off until you run /monitor.

alwaysOn.title: Show Monitor in every session
alwaysOn.description: Off: Monitor stays hidden, with no band, no pane and no plan tool, until you run /monitor in a session. On: it starts with every session.

issuePrefixes.title: Linear team keys
issuePrefixes.description: Comma-separated Linear team keys, for example ENG,OPS. Monitor finds these issue ids in the branch name or the PR title and shows the issue (set LINEAR_API_KEY). Empty: no Linear row.

chromeSlotsDirectory.title: Chrome slots folder
chromeSlotsDirectory.description: A folder under your home, for example .cache/myapp/browser-slots, holding one <profile>-slot-<n>.lock folder per debugging Chrome with an owner.json of its worktree and pid. Empty: no Chrome row.

fixCommand.title: Fix command
fixCommand.description: A slash command, without the slash, that a Fix button runs with the PR number, for example fix-pr. Empty: no Fix buttons.
